Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Turn the built-in D13 LED on and off. Learn the order of statements and milliseconds. Wiring: Only the Pro Mini and USB–Serial adapter; use the built-in L / D13 LED. Try: Change both wait values from 1000 to 200 ms and compare the blink rate.
